text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The day of the 1st Live has finally 
arrived. Smart Falcon takes it upon 
herself to make the live a roaring success 
so that she can win everyone's 
cooperation.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Winning Concerts, however, are meant for 
everyone to enjoy together. Upon hearing 
that, she darted out onto the stage with a 
radiant expression.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Among those in the stands were Agnes 
Tachyon and Silence Suzuka. And Mihono 
Bourbon, whom she had spoken to yesterday, 
was there as well.
